contracts.name: R5.1 shares of every expense sum to its amount and differ by at most one cent
R5.2 balances are paid minus shares and sum to exactly zero
R5.3 settling zeroes every balance with positive whole-cent payments, at most one fewer than people owing or owed
R5.4 reading the same file twice, or its lines in another order, gives the same balances
R5.5 a failing property reports the seed and the smallest failing party so it can be replayed
R1.1 records payer, whole-cent amount and what for each line
R1.2 shares a split line among the listed names and other lines among everyone
R1.3 treats names that differ in case or spaces as one person with the first spelling
R1.4 stops with the line number and one plain sentence for a bad line
R1.5 skips empty lines and lines that start with #
R2.1 gives each sharer the floor and the extra cents to the first names alphabetically
R2.2 makes balances paid minus shares and sums them to exactly zero
R3.1 produces positive whole-cent payments that bring every balance to zero
R3.2 pays from the biggest debtor to the biggest creditor, ties by name, same every run
R3.3 prints All square. and no payments when every balance is zero
R4.1 prints the balances table then one pays line per payment with two decimals
R4.2 prints balances and payments as JSON with amounts in integer cents
R4.3 exits 1 with one plain sentence when the file is missing or unreadable
